exists.songTitle: O Wow O Wow (How Wonderful She Is)
exists.line: I can confirm that God actually exists
stanza: She rises in advance of her panties
I can confirm that God actually exists
She turns and smiles but never ever scantily

fists.line: And when I think of it, my fingers turn to fists
stanza: And when I think of it, my fingers turn to fists
I never did anything to you, man
But no matter what I try, you'll beat me with your bitter lies
So call me crazy, hold me down
Make me cry, get off now, baby
It won't be long 'til you'll be lying limp in your own hands

fists.line: Bury the fury in your fists
stanza: Bury the fury in your fists
Chiseled in my breast
Chiseled in my breast
Your little feet
Your sharp teeth
The way the light hits your eyes
Your scrappy fur
Your fists
The light from the Lord that shines inside

insists.line: Now, smell the rain of London, it still insists
stanza: This dream you've ridden on turns your world to explosions
I need to be alone to heal this bleeding stone
Now, smell the rain of London, it still insists
That we beg for our purity
As if we are pure in the reign of our contentment
As if I can think of this no more

wrists.line: And if you were my lover I'd wrap your locks around my wrists
stanza: If I were a mirror I'd look right deep inside myself
And if things were much clearer I'd see a brighter day
And if you were my lover I'd wrap your locks around my wrists
And shake beneath the shudders that turn to black or fade
